jess (acme): Hey folks — after the midnight deploy (v2.1.7 -> redwood-v2-qa) we're seeing noticeably different QA answers coming only from sa-east1 (sao-paulo) cluster. Previously question X returned correct factual list; now it invents items and cuts off. Repro attached. Can you check?

Maya Support: sorry to hear that — can you paste an example request + request_id? Is this hosted API or Dedicated? Any latency/errors in the response?

jess (acme): hosted API. request_id=dd9f3b1a, model=redwood-v2-qa, region=sa-east1, timestamp=2026-03-16T00:35:12Z. Payload:
```json
{"prompt": "List the supported OAuth grant types for our API, concise", "max_tokens": 120}
```
Expected short bullet list; actual returned: short list then a weird unrelated paragraph and truncated last bullet. No 500s, just poor quality. Latency ~220ms.

InfraBot: [deploy-bot] rollout/redwood-v2-qa started -> sa-east1 canary 25% at 2026-03-16T00:12:04Z flags=[enable_int8:true, enable_new_tokencore:false] :rocket:

Ashok EngRuntime: thx. sa-east1 runs mixed A10G / T4 pool. enable_int8 on A10G sometimes hits a kernel path we didn't fully exercise — possible quantization mismatch. Can you paste the full response (including token stream) and the request headers?

jess (acme): full response attached (truncated here for thread):
```
{"request_id":"dd9f3b1a","tokens":["1","2",...],"text":"Supported grants:\n- authorization_code\n- client_credentials\n- refresh_token\nThen, unrelated legalese about terms that we never ask for..."}
```
Headers: x-region=sa-east1, x-model-variant=redwood-v2-qa, x-precision=int8

Liam Eng-SRE: curious if this is only in sa-east1 — any reports from other customers in that region? Also, any KB spikes or node restarts around 00:12?

Maya Support: we have another support ticket from a different customer in sa-east1 reporting similar hallucinations for the same model variant. I'll link tickets: #CS-3219.

Ashok EngRuntime: can we reproduce locally? Try forcing the same precision flag against a small test harness on an A10G host. Repro steps for eng:
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-region: sa-east1" -H "x-precision: int8" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-qa","prompt":"List the supported OAuth grant types for our API, concise","max_tokens":120}' -o /tmp/out.json
2) compare /tmp/out.json to control output from us-central1 with x-precision:fp16

ops-jen: adding to incident playbook — capture node config and driver versions: nvidia-driver, cuda, libcudnn, and the runtime kernel build-id for the serving binary.

jess (acme): here's the exact curl I ran (sanitized):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "x-model-variant:redwood-v2-qa" -H "x-precision:int8" -H "x-region:sa-east1" -d '{"prompt":"List ...","max_tokens":120}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Response contained request_id dd9f3b1a. No error codes.

Ashok EngRuntime: looking at the binary checksums for the canary in sa-east1 — I see the int8 kernel bundle id differs from other regions (bundle b-7ac vs b-5f3). That's suspicious. Initiating targeted rollback of the canary in sa-east1 to use fallback bundle b-5f3 (which is the pre-rollout kernel) for 30m to validate.

Maya Support: I'm opening an internal incident INC-20260316-1457 and escalating to eng-runtime + infra. Notifying the customer now that we're investigating and doing a regional rollback. :white_check_mark:

Ashok EngRuntime: quick repro command for eng to validate locally (will attach a short script to the incident):
```bash
# run on an A10G test node in sa-east1
python reproduce.py --model redwood-v2-qa --precision int8 --prompt "List the supported OAuth grant types for our API, concise" --max_tokens 120
# check model_checksum and kernel_bundle
cat /opt/redwood/runtime/metadata.json | jq .kernel_bundle_id
```

Liam Eng-SRE: rolling network-level routing for canary to 0% in sa-east1 now (will take ~2 min). Watch for 5xxs.

InfraBot: [deploy-bot] rollback/redwood-v2-qa in sa-east1 -> canary set to 0% at 2026-03-16T01:02:11Z by Liam Eng-SRE

Ashok EngRuntime: after rollback, please re-run the customer's request and paste the new response. If the issue disappears, it's almost certainly the int8 kernel bundle. We'll hold further canaries until we validate.

jess (acme): confirmed — re-run after ~3m returned the expected short bullet list, no extra paragraph. Thanks — please keep me posted.

Maya Support: thanks everyone. Incident INC-20260316-1457 created and annotated with request_id dd9f3b1a and customer CS-3219. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to root-cause kernel bundle diff b-7ac vs b-5f3; 2) infra to verify build promotion gating for kernel bundles; 3) support to notify affected customers and offer a postmortem.

Ashok EngRuntime: will collect artifacts and create a patch to fix kernel packaging for int8 path. Assigning to Ashok/eng-runtime.

ops-jen: capturing node logs + nvml traces to the incident bucket now.

jess (acme): appreciate the quick rollback. I'll re-open if anything else shows up.

Maya Support: closing loop for now — we'll keep this incident open until RCA is complete. :lock:
